fingerprints.json: sums of the road surface buffers and route points that
tests/roadModelInvariance.test.ts computes from the frozen tiles of ../sign-placement (JARTIC
regulations and OpenStreetMap turn:lanes; sources and licences in ../sign-placement/LICENSE.txt),
taken with the code of origin/main 1305f52 (before P2 of the road redesign, knowledge/road-model.md).
Rewrite only with ROAD_MODEL_UPDATE=1 under the conditions written at the top of that test.
